description: This file defines the class 'ModifyFeatureDefinitionResponse', which is a response object for a specific command related to modifying feature definitions in a 'things' model. It handles JSON serialization/deserialization, defines how the response is created for various status scenarios, and provides accessors to the modified feature's details.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionResponse
classes.description: Immutable response class for handling the outcome of modifying a feature definition. Supports creation from JSON, accessors for response data, and proper equality and string representation methods.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response object indicating a feature definition was created, with appropriate HTTP status. Deprecated method accepting String for thingId.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response object indicating a feature definition was modified, with appropriate HTTP status. Deprecated method accepting String for thingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a response object from a JSON string or JSON object, given the headers of the preceding command.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the related 'Thing' entity.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose definition was modified.

methods.name: getFeatureDefinitionCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created FeatureDefinition if available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the feature definition entity, if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the resource within the object structure.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the instance's data to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicates.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.description: Computes the hash code for this object.
